class.name: NNBTBlackboardHas
class.brief_description: Checks whether a key exists in the behaviour tree blackboard.
class.description: Returns [code]SUCCESS[/code] when [member key] exists in the effective [NNBlackboard] of the nearest [NNBTRoot] ancestor and its stored value is not [code]null[/code]. Returns [code]FAILURE[/code] for a missing key or a null-valued key without an engine error. A missing [NNBTRoot] ancestor with a blackboard, or an empty [member key], is a configuration error that is reported once per node instance and returns [code]FAILURE[/code]. This leaf is fully data-driven: it is configured entirely by its properties, does not call and is not affected by an [code]on_tick[/code] override in an attached script, and works on the effective [NNBlackboard] of the nearest [NNBTRoot] ancestor through the [NoodleNodes] blackboard helpers.

members.member: The blackboard key to check. Must be non-empty; an empty key reports an error once and returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE]. Missing or [code]null[/code] values return [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE].
